newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bordeaux airport air traffic up three pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bordeaux airport air traffic up three pct in 1996.

text.p: Bordeaux's Merignac airport said it handled 8,270 tonnes of air cargo traffic last year up three percent on 1995.
In September 1996, United Parcel Service, launched a weekday feeder service between Lyon-Satolas airport and Bordeaux using two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
Bordeaux also features on DHL's Worldwide Express' weekday Brussels-western France air cargo service.
Airfreight is also carried in the bellyholds of passenger aircraft operating domestic, European and long-haul services from Bordeaux.
Several airlines also operate trucking services for airfreight from Bordeaux.
